text:
An electrical appliance is powered from a mains supply.
The appliance normally uses a current of 3A, but the current briefly rises to 4A at the instant the
appliance is switched on. The cable to the appliance is designed for currents up to 6A.
A fuse is used to protect the circuit.
What should be the rating of the fuse?
A
1A
B
3A
C
5A
D
13A
subject: Physics
